contradicted.instructions: `anchor.statement` says on a sanity FAIL below the round cap the sanity close hook reopens the checked bead to its assignee and sends that dev the sanity-fail.xml.j2 template naming each undone deliverable on the dev's still-open task, creating no finding bead, new layer or new task. Does `item.text` plan any of these: (1) creating finding beads or child beads for a sanity FAIL; (2) cutting a new layer or branch for the fix; (3) creating or assigning a new ATM task for the fix; (4) not reopening the checked bead on a FAIL that is below the round cap? Silence is never a conflict. Also not a conflict: silence about FAIL handling; escalating to the lead without reopening when a FAIL reaches max_sanity_rounds, because the statement covers only FAILs below the cap; incrementing the round counter. Judge conflict only.
